problem.title: Built for how shops actually sell on installment
problem.item1Description: Every contract generates its own payment schedule automatically — no manual math, no missed rows.
problem.item2Description: Daily reminders go out on Telegram, and you can send any customer their balance on WhatsApp in one tap.
problem.item3Title: No easy way for customers to check their balance
problem.item3Description: Every customer gets their own page — a link or a QR code — showing exactly what they've paid and what's next. No app to install.

howItWorks.title: Up and running in three steps
howItWorks.step1Description: Their name and phone number — that's all it takes.
howItWorks.step2Description: Set the price, the down payment, and how many installments. The schedule builds itself.
howItWorks.step3Description: Send the link, a QR code, or straight to WhatsApp.

trust.title: This isn't a loan app
trust.body: We don't lend money, charge interest, or run credit checks. You agree on the price, the down payment, and the schedule with your own customer — we just help you track it, remind everyone, and keep it organized.
trust.point1: You set every term — we never touch pricing or interest
trust.point2: Your customers' data stays between you and them
trust.point3: No approval process, no waiting — start today

faq.title: Questions shop owners actually ask
faq.q1: Do you lend money to my customers?
faq.a1: No. This is software only — you and your customer agree on the price and schedule yourselves. We just track it, send reminders, and give your customer a page to check their balance.
faq.q2: Does my customer need to install anything?
faq.a2: No. They get a link (or a QR code) to a page that works in any browser — no app, no account.
faq.a3: Yes. Each shop's data is fully isolated — only you and the specific customer can see their balance.
faq.q4: Can I use my own shop's branding?
faq.a4: Yes — upload your logo and pick a brand color, and it carries across your dashboard and your customers' pages.
faq.a5: Yes, fully — Arabic and English, with proper right-to-left layout throughout.
faq.a6: It's currently free to use while we're in early access.
